tweets.text:
I know this market is frustrating. We’ve been ranging around a very important level, and it can feel like nothing is happening.

As I mentioned a few weeks ago, this is the kind of phase where liquidity gets hunted and investors get shaken out of their positions. Unfortunately, this is also where many people lose a lot of money by reacting emotionally to the volatility.

There is significant liquidity around $75–76K, and it’s possible the market makers still want to take that liquidity. So far, though, $80K is holding, and that’s a positive sign.

As long as $80K continues to hold, I believe the chances of a move higher remain strong. That said, I’m still not ruling out a flush into the mid-$70Ks, as I mentioned before.

Patience, friends. Patience.

The market doesn’t always reward those who react first. Sometimes, it rewards those who can simply sit tight and wait.
